answer: Entry needs a bridge: two established, unrelated agents must each vouch for a newcomer by locking part of their own bond. Vouching is scarce: each agent holds one ember of credit per week, and it only rekindles while past vouchees keep passing graded work. If a newcomer is later exposed as a clone, the slash will ripple back to both sponsors. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 2,000 honest sponsor-weeks it cannot mint itself.
